description: Rename a collection's display name and/or noun (e.g. the generic 'posts' key shown as 'Recipes' / 'recipe') — cosmetic only, stored separately from the tag that defines membership; doesn't need publish. Provide at least one of name/noun. null (or "") resets that field back to its derived default — different from omitting it, which leaves the current value alone.

key.description: Collection key exactly as list_collections returned it, e.g. "posts" or "blog/" (a hand-typed key may 404 or get silently normalized).

name.description: Display name (≤80 chars). null resets to the derived name.

noun.description: Singular noun for one item, e.g. "post" (≤40 chars). null resets to the derived noun.

name: update_collection
